body: The harbor buoy rings through the water like a bell, but it doesn't ring out clearly. My eyes scan the area, searching for any sign of movement or disturbance. I step closer, my hand instinctively touching the metal surface, feeling its coolness in contrast to the warmth of the sun on my skin.
